source_evidence: RAUM is a specialized calculation of the assets over which an adviser provides investment advice.
answer: Regulatory assets under management (RAUM) is a specialized measure of the assets an investment adviser provides advice on. The source groups advisers by RAUM: small advisers have less than $25 million, mid-sized advisers have between $25 million and $100 million, and large advisers have greater than $100 million. These categories generally relate to whether an adviser is regulated primarily by state securities authorities or the SEC, though exceptions apply.
